note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written for this page, in its own words, with the source of each fact named beside it. Triggers the sources have not pinned down are marked unconfirmed, never invented.

trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy on the list and this one unlocks by itself. Work the roadmap below in order — story first, the one missable trophy second, the grinds last — and the Platinum lands when the final trophy pops.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — just follow the on-screen prompts through the intro and the trophy pops at the end of it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play the chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen. While you are still in Chapter 1, start the Positive Mental Attitude spots — that is the one trophy you can leave behind.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Keep playing the story missions in order; nothing optional is needed for this one and it pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story only — finish the chapter's final mission and the trophy pops with it.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story only — play the chapter through to its last mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Finish the last story mission and the trophy pops as the credits roll. It is the gold that closes the story arc, before the 100% cleanup for A Long Road.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the story — take the mission when it appears on the map and finish it to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission — play it when it unlocks and finish the job to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story mission — finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story mission — finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story mission — finish the airport job and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission — finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long one: finish the story, all the stranger strands, the activities, the collectibles and whatever the in-game 100% tracker counts. Open the stats screen to see what is still missing — the roadmap's final stage lists the usual suspects, and the last few percent are almost always collectibles or a challenge you skipped.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts. Stunts count when you catch air with style — jumps, near misses and long airtime all feed the counter, which is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so you will likely be most of the way there by the end of the story. For the remainder, find a long jump you can repeat and run it until the counter hits 250. Unconfirmed: exactly which moves the game counts as a stunt is not pinned down yet — jumps and airtime are the safe bet.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample one of everything — fishing, racing, the shooting range, bowling, the arcade, drone races and the rest — and the trophy pops when the ninth type registers. Unconfirmed: the full list of the 9 types is not pinned down yet, so work through every activity the map offers until it pops.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through every range challenge and hit the gold score on each; replay any you miss until it turns gold. The later challenges have tight gold thresholds, so take your time and learn each one's layout before going for gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Visit each drone race spot on the map and take first place there; the trophy pops after the fourteenth win. Learn the gates on each course — a clean line beats raw speed.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, as long as each win is at a different race — repeat wins at the same event do not add to the total. Work through the race list on the map and tick them off one by one.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and out-fish him in the challenge — steady reeling beats fast reeling, and letting the line slack at the right moment keeps the fish on. Unconfirmed: Cal's exact spot is not pinned down yet.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk up to any arcade cabinet, start a game and see it through to the end — any cabinet, any game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's mission strand to its last job and the trophy pops when it ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map — take each strand to its end. There are more than 8 strands in the game, so you can skip one you dislike and still pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: the first meditation spots appear in Chapter 1, so start meditating as soon as the prompt appears and do not leave Chapter 1 spots behind — if a spot locks with the chapter, the trophy may need a new playthrough. Meditation spots reveal themselves when you are near them; sit through the full meditation at each one and the counter ticks up.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at a one-off animal — track it down, take the shot, and bring the proof back to Bret. Unconfirmed: which animal it is has not been pinned down yet.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a full set needs every card in it, so check the in-game collection screen to see which sets are still missing cards, then sweep those areas. Unconfirmed: the total number of cards in the game is not pinned down yet.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo and check-in feature — open it at 100 different spots around the map and the counter ticks once per location. Spread it out: hit a WAiNK It every time you pass somewhere new instead of saving them all for the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small objectives scattered through activities and free roam — open the challenges menu to see your progress and what is left, then knock out the easy ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Get the heat up to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears. Alleys and tunnels break the search faster than open roads.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Chain three shop robberies in one run with your partner alongside — keep moving between shops and do not let the wanted level drop between them. Plan the route first so the third shop is close to the second.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles — the collection log counts each new model once, so variety beats repetition. Car parks, traffic and mission vehicles all add to the log.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of at least five, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends. A crowded shootout is the place to try it — do not waste it on two stragglers.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Find a way out of Vice City International Airport that is not on the timetable — a runway run in a stolen plane is the classic route. Unconfirmed: the exact trigger has not been pinned down yet.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Survive the Rhinos. When the tanks roll in, stay alive through the encounter — keep moving, use cover, and do not try to fight them head-on. Unconfirmed: the exact trigger has not been pinned down yet.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no one spotting you — and get out with the goods before anyone raises the alarm. Scope the store first and pick the quietest hour.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vault robberies are bigger jobs — plan the approach, crack the vault, and lose the heat afterwards. Five successful escapes pop the trophy; each vault counts once, so find five different ones.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on its route, hit it, grab the cash and break away before the response arrives. A quiet stretch of road beats a busy one.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you visit each named area — the last few are the small ones off the main roads, so sweep the edges of the map and the islands at the end until the counter reads 52.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations somewhere in Leonida — hit one per gang and the trophy pops. The operations map fills in as you find them.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach spot, order the cocktail and take in the view — the trophy pops once the moment plays out. Unconfirmed: the exact venue has not been pinned down yet.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through the showroom front — the trophy is for the exit, not the purchase. Unconfirmed: which showroom has not been pinned down yet.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Play a frame at that alley and see it through to the end — any score counts, finishing is what matters.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one pops from a story moment with your partner — play the story and it comes to you. Unconfirmed: the exact trigger has not been pinned down yet.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Make choices as the story offers them — PlayStation tracks a count toward 500, so keep choosing rather than skipping past decision moments. Unconfirmed: exactly what the game counts as a choice has not been pinned down yet.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the retry — the trophy is for the comeback, not the first attempt. Unconfirmed: the exact trigger has not been pinned down yet.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — find the odd encounter and see it through. Unconfirmed: the exact trigger has not been pinned down yet.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While riding past on a bike or driving past in a car, swing a melee weapon and knock someone down. Speed helps — a slow roll past will not land it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — hand them to a contact to wash them, and the total climbs with each batch. Rob, wash, repeat; the big vault jobs pay the fastest.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, fuel and gear — every shop purchase counts toward the total, so it climbs on its own as you play. If you are short at the end, the expensive shops close the gap fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from the property listings — own all eight and the trophy pops. Save the buying spree for when the money is flowing from the later story jobs.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register a vehicle, repeat — ten different vehicles earns the trophy. Any vehicle you drive can be registered, so do it as you discover new ones for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: On the Spot
